welcome_subtitle: The definitive platform for gaining mass.
other_options_coming_soon: More sign-in options are on the way.
agree_prefix: BY CONTINUING YOU AGREE TO THE
baseline_subtitle:
Accurate metrics ensure precise
progression tracking.
baseline_footnote: Your body composition drives every number that follows. Tap any field to adjust it.
username_invalid: Use 3-50 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only.
username_taken_error: That username is already taken. Try another.
activity_level_subtitle:
Be honest here. Most people overestimate,
and an inflated burn rate means a target
you never actually hit.
sedentary_desc: Desk job, little to no exercise.
extra_active_desc: Physical job and hard daily training.
target_pace_subtitle: Set the weight you're chasing and how fast you intend to get there.
lean_bulk_hint: This pace keeps gains lean. Muscle is built slowly; anything faster is mostly fat.
lean_bulk_warning: Above 0.5 kg (1 lb) per week, the extra weight is usually fat rather than muscle. Consider easing off for a leaner bulk.
target_below_current: Your target needs to be above your current mass of {weight}.
calorie_goal_desc: Fuel for maximum growth. Hit this target daily to ensure constant surplus and brutal strength gains.
onboarding_error_incomplete: Some details are missing. Go back and complete the previous steps.
home_placeholder_body: Your plan is saved. The dashboard, food logging and progress tracking land here next.
section_coming_soon: This section is on the way.
chart_needs_more_data: Log another weigh-in to see your trend.
nutrition_plan_desc: Calculated from your metrics at a {activity} lifestyle. Hit this daily to keep the surplus consistent.
profile_missing: We couldn't find your profile. Finish onboarding to create it.
nutrition_plan_desc_pace: Calculated from your metrics at a {activity} lifestyle, targeting +{pace} {unit} per week.
plan_stale_notice: Your weight has caught up with this target, so it no longer buys a surplus. Recalculate to keep gaining.
recalculate_desc: Recomputed against your current weight. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
save_failed: Couldn't save that. Check your connection and try again.
insight_first_weigh_in_body: One number is all it takes to start the trend. Everything else on this screen builds on it.
insight_weigh_in_due_body: It has been {days} days. Step on the scale first thing tomorrow and the trend stays honest.
insight_consistency_body: {count} weigh-ins logged. The trend is only as good as the habit behind it.
insight_target_reached_body: You are at {target} kg. Set a new target, or ease back to maintenance and hold it.
insight_plan_stale_body: At {weight} kg your body burns what your target feeds it, so there is no surplus left. Recalculate to keep gaining.
insight_pace_fast_body: +{rate} kg a week is above the {ceiling} kg lean ceiling. More than this tends to arrive as fat — consider easing the surplus.
insight_pace_stalled_body: No gain over your recent weigh-ins. Either the food is not going in, or the target needs to go up.
insight_pace_behind_body: Averaging +{rate} kg a week against a +{target} kg target. One more solid meal a day usually closes that gap.
insight_protein_body: {grams} g today — roughly {perMeal} g across {meals} meals. Build each meal around it and the rest is easier.
insight_water_body: About {glasses} glasses at your bodyweight, and more on training days. Being under makes you feel flat and hungry.
insight_weigh_method_body: First thing in the morning, after the toilet, before food or drink. Same conditions each time is what makes the line mean something.
insight_move_body: Twenty minutes lifts what you burn, so more of what you eat has somewhere useful to go.
insight_sleep_body: Seven to nine hours. Growth happens between sessions, not during them, and short nights blunt both appetite and recovery.
insight_eat_consistently_body: Weekends included. A surplus you hit five days out of seven is not the surplus you planned for.
insight_water_body_oz: About {glasses} glasses at your bodyweight, and more on training days. Being under makes you feel flat and hungry.
recalculate_needs_biometrics: Recalculating needs your date of birth, which is missing from your profile.
meals_empty_mine_body: Build your first meal and it lands here, ready to log in one tap.
meals_empty_favorites_body: Tap the star on a meal to keep it at the front of the queue.
meal_recipe_hint: Sear 3 minutes a side, rest 8, slice against the grain...
meal_ingredients_empty: Add ingredients and the calories and macros are totalled for you. Skip them and enter the totals yourself.
meal_public_helper: Others can find and save this meal.
food_search_subtitle: Searched across Open Food Facts and our own list.
food_search_prompt: Type at least two letters to search for a food.
food_search_empty: No food matched that. Try a simpler name — "chicken breast" rather than a brand.
meal_delete_helper: Gone for good. Past days you logged it keep their calories.
meal_delete_public_helper: Gone for good, and out of the library of anyone who saved it. Past days you logged it keep their calories.
meal_remove_helper: The meal stays with whoever made it. You can save it again later.
meal_delete_confirm_public_body: "{meal}" will be gone for good, and will disappear from the meals of anyone who saved it.
meal_saved_without_ingredients: Meal saved with the right calories, but its ingredient list couldn't be stored. Check the Supabase policies on cached_off_foods.
barcode_scan_subtitle: Point at the barcode on the packet.
barcode_camera_unavailable: The camera isn't available. Check Bulkr has camera permission, or search for the food by name instead.
barcode_not_found: Nothing found for {barcode}. Try searching by name.
meal_edit_helper: Change the name, photo, ingredients or recipe.
meal_edit_copy_helper: You can't change someone else's meal, but you can save your own version.
feed_empty_for_you_body: For you shows the people and groups you follow. Follow a few and their posts land here.
feed_empty_discover_body: Discover shows what the community is posting. Be the one who starts it.
feed_empty_filtered_body: Nothing under this label yet. Clear the filter to see everything.
post_prompt_meal: What did you make? Drop the recipe.
post_prompt_workout: What did you train? Sets, reps, how it felt.
post_prompt_progress: How far have you come? Add the photos.
post_prompt_tip: What do you know that others should?
post_prompt_question: What do you want to know?
post_photos_suggested: This kind of post lands better with a photo.
post_no_meals: No meals in your library yet.
post_hidden_notice: Hidden — only you can see this.
post_hide_helper: Takes it off the feed. You can put it back.
post_unhide_helper: Puts it back on the feed.
post_meal_will_publish: Posting this shares the meal publicly, so readers can open and save it.
comments_empty_question: No answers yet. If you know, tell them.
profile_not_found_body: This account doesn't exist, or never finished signing up.
profile_no_posts_mine_body: Whatever you post shows up here and in your followers' feeds.
groups_empty_mine_body: Groups are a smaller feed — posts in one only show up for its members.
groups_empty_discover_body: Nobody's started one. Be the first.
groups_public_helper: Anyone can find it and read it. Only members can post.
groups_private_helper: Hidden from everyone who isn't a member, posts included.
group_not_found_body: This group doesn't exist, or it's private and you're not a member.
post_share_helper: Puts the post and a link on your clipboard.
report_explainer: Reports are anonymous. Once enough people report a post, it comes off the feed automatically.
report_reason_spam_helper: Adverts, scams, or the same thing posted over and over.
report_reason_misinformation_helper: Advice that could hurt someone who follows it.
report_reason_inappropriate_helper: Sexual, graphic, or otherwise not what this app is for.
report_reason_other_helper: Tell us in your own words.
challenge_setup_explainer: Measured in weight gained since joining, from the weight you already log. The leaderboard shows how much each person has gained — never what anyone weighs.
challenge_joined: You're in. Progress counts from today's weight.
challenge_leaderboard_empty: Nobody has joined this challenge yet.
search_no_results_body: Check the spelling, or try a handle.
search_all_groups_helper: Discover groups, or start your own.
search_empty_start_body: There's nobody else here yet. Once other people join, they'll turn up in search.
profile_edit_about_hint: What you're working on, how you train, anything
tracker_add_food_helper: One-off — it won't be added to your meals
tracker_add_food_subtitle: Search or scan. Logged straight to your day.
tracker_no_meals: Your library is empty. Create a meal first.
tracker_no_profile: Finish onboarding to get your daily targets.
food_scan_unknown: Nothing known for that barcode. Try searching by name.
water_goal_derived: Left alone, your goal is {perKg} ml per kg of bodyweight and moves as you bulk.
water_unavailable: Water isn't set up yet. Run tracker_water.sql and pull to refresh.
search_create_group_helper: Name it, invite people, post in it
visibility_public_helper: Anyone on Bulkr, and it can appear in Discover
post_hide_from_feed_helper: You stop seeing it. Nobody is told.
post_block_confirm_body: You won't see {name}'s posts or comments, and they won't see yours. You'll both be unfollowed. They aren't told. You can undo this from your profile.
account_blocked_helper: See who you've blocked, and undo it
account_delete_body: This cannot be undone. Your profile, posts, comments, meals, food and water logs, weigh-ins and photos are permanently deleted, and your replies disappear from other people's threads.
account_delete_failed: Couldn't delete your account. Nothing was changed.
saved_posts_empty: Nothing saved yet. Tap the bookmark on a post to keep it here.
profile_unblock_helper: You'll be able to see each other again
account_edit_profile_helper: Your name and what you're working on
account_create_group_helper: Name it, invite people, post in it
